title: Azoth case
description: A case file: one model to run, and the instances of it with the answer each must reproduce.

model.description: The id of the model this file instantiates; every case in the file is a run of that model. A name that resolves to no model is refused.

cases.description: One entry per machine to run. Named, because a failing case has to be nameable in a report.

id.description: The case's name, unique within the model. What a failure names.

inputs.description: The instance's inputs, keyed by the model's declared input names. Every one must be declared, and `spec_lint` refuses a key the model does not take.

expected.description: The output values this run must reproduce, keyed by the model's declared output names. A key the model does not declare is refused.

tolerance.description: Relative tolerance for every expected value in this case. Stated per case rather than per model, because it is a property of the run.

source.description: Where the expected values came from, when they did not come from running the model.
